body: Aalborg Biblioteker ændrer åbningstiderne på Hovedbiblioteket fra den første mandag i næste måned. Mandag til onsdag holder huset åbent fra 10 til 19. Torsdag forlænges aftenåbningen til klokken 21, så studerende kan bruge læsesalen efter undervisning. Fredag lukker biblioteket klokken 17, og lørdag er der åbent fra 10 til 14. Søndag forbliver lukket, bortset fra to søndage i december hvor der holdes juleværksted for familier. Kommunen oplyser, at den længere torsdag er finansieret ved at flytte to medarbejdere fra morgenvagten. Borgere kan stadig aflevere bøger i boksen ved indgangen hele døgnet. Direktøren siger, at ændringen evalueres efter et halvt år, og at der tages særligt hensyn til læsesalens belægning i eksamensperioder.
translated: Aalborg Libraries will change opening hours at the Main Library from the first Monday of next month. Monday to Wednesday the building will be open from 10 to 19. Thursday evening hours are extended to 21 so students can use the reading room after class. The library closes at 17 on Friday and is open 10 to 14 on Saturday. Sunday stays closed except for two Sundays in December with a family Christmas workshop. The municipality says the longer Thursday is funded by moving two staff members off the morning shift. Residents can still return books to the drop box at the entrance around the clock. The director says the change will be evaluated after six months, with special attention to reading-room occupancy during exam periods.
summary: Aalborg's main library will change its opening hours next month, including Thursday evenings until 21. Sundays stay closed except for two December family workshops, and the change will be reviewed after six months.

body: Hjørring Kommune inviterer til borgermøde onsdag aften i Kulturcenteret om et forslag til seks nye kystnære vindmøller nordvest for byen. Forvaltningen har sendt et foreløbigt plangrundlag i høring, og mødet er tænkt som en gennemgang af støjberegninger, skyggekast og den foreslåede adgangsvej fra landevejen. Borgmesteren åbner med en kort status, hvorefter teknikere fra planafdelingen viser kort over opstillingsmønsteret. Tre lodsejere har allerede indsendt høringssvar, der advarer om gener for sommerhusområdet tæt på kysten. Danmarks Naturfredningsforening lokalafdeling støtter projektet, hvis der stilles krav om midlertidige arbejdsveje og retablering af klitfredede arealer. Tilmelding er ikke nødvendig, men kommunen beder deltagere møde op senest klokken 18.45, så der er tid til at uddele spørgesedler. Referatet offentliggøres på kommunens høringsportal inden fjorten dage.
translated: Hjørring Municipality is inviting residents to a public meeting Wednesday evening at the Culture Centre about a proposal for six new near-shore wind turbines northwest of town. The administration has released a draft planning basis for consultation, and the meeting is meant as a walkthrough of noise calculations, shadow flicker, and the proposed access road from the highway. The mayor will open with a short status, after which planners will show maps of the layout. Three landowners have already submitted consultation replies warning about disturbance to the summer-house area near the coast. The local chapter of the Danish Society for Nature Conservation supports the project if temporary work roads and restoration of protected dune areas are required. Registration is not required, but the municipality asks people to arrive by 18.45 so question sheets can be handed out. Minutes will be published on the consultation portal within fourteen days.
summary: Hjørring will hold a Wednesday evening public meeting on six proposed coastal wind turbines. Officials will present noise and access-road plans, and minutes will appear on the consultation portal within two weeks.

body: Frederikshavn Byråd har godkendt anlægsbevillingen til en ny fløj på Bangsbo Skole. Byggeriet skal rumme to faglokaler til fysik og billedkunst samt en fælles projektzone til udskolingen. Ifølge forvaltningen kan første spadestik tages efter vinterferien, hvis den seneste udbudsrunde holder tidsplanen. Den eksisterende pavillon, som klassen i 8. årgang bruger i dag, rives ned når den nye fløj er klar. Skolelederen understreger, at undervisningen fortsætter i de øvrige bygninger, og at idrætshallen ikke berøres. Anlægsbudgettet er 18,4 millioner kroner, heraf 1,2 millioner til inventar og stinkskabe. Forældrebestyrelsen har bedt om en sikker cykelsti fra Poul Paghs Vej i anlægsperioden, og teknik- og miljøudvalget behandler den anmodning på næste møde. Indflytning er planlagt til skolestart året efter, men ledelsen kalder datoen et mål, ikke et løfte.
translated: Frederikshavn Town Council has approved the construction grant for a new wing at Bangsbo School. The building will hold two specialist rooms for physics and visual art plus a shared project zone for lower secondary. The administration says the first sod can be turned after the winter holiday if the latest tender stays on schedule. The existing pavilion used by year 8 will be demolished once the new wing is ready. The headteacher stresses that teaching continues in the other buildings and that the sports hall is unaffected. The construction budget is 18.4 million kroner, including 1.2 million for furniture and fume cupboards. The parent board has asked for a safe cycle path from Poul Paghs Vej during construction, and the technical and environment committee will take that request at its next meeting. Move-in is planned for the following school start, but leadership calls the date a target, not a promise.
summary: Frederikshavn has funded an 18.4 million kroner wing at Bangsbo School for science, art, and project rooms. Work may start after the winter holiday, with move-in targeted for the following school year.

body: Viborg Museum holder ekstraordinær søndagsåbning i næste weekend i forbindelse med en ny særudstilling om byens middelalderlige værksteder. Udstillingen viser fund fra de seneste to gravninger ved Sct. Mogens Gade, blandt andet værktøjsspor i træ og en næsten hel drejeskive. Der er omvisning klokken 11 og 14. Begge ture varer omkring 40 minutter og kræver gratis billet via museets hjemmeside. Caféen i kælderen serverer æbleskiver og kaffe, og overskuddet går til formidling for skoleklasser. Museet rykker også to montrer ud i gården, hvis vejret tillader det, så gæster kan se kopier, de må røre ved. Direktøren siger, at søndagsåbningen er et forsøg, og at faste søndage først kommer på tale, hvis mindst 400 gæster kommer forbi. Medlemmer af venneforeningen går gratis ind hele weekenden.
translated: Viborg Museum will hold an extra Sunday opening next weekend for a new special exhibition on the town's medieval workshops. The exhibition shows finds from the last two excavations on Sct. Mogens Gade, including tool marks in wood and an almost complete potter's wheel. Guided tours are at 11 and 14. Both last about 40 minutes and need a free ticket from the museum website. The basement café will serve apple dumplings and coffee, with proceeds going to school outreach. The museum will also move two cases into the courtyard if the weather allows, so visitors can handle replica objects. The director says the Sunday opening is a trial, and regular Sundays will only be considered if at least 400 guests attend. Friends-of-the-museum members enter free all weekend.
summary: Viborg Museum will open extra on Sunday for a medieval workshop exhibition, with free booked tours at 11 and 14. Regular Sunday hours depend on attracting at least 400 visitors.

body: Skagen Havnefest vender tilbage i den anden uge af juli med tre dages program på kajen ved fiskerihavnen. Torsdag aften åbner med lokale foodtrucks og en kort koncert fra havnens eget kor. Fredag er der marked for jollefiskere og en børneworkshop, hvor man kan male fiskekasser. Lørdag slutter med fællesspisning og fyrværkeri klokken 22, hvis beredskabet godkender den endelige sikkerhedsplan. Arrangørerne forventer omkring 8.000 gæster over de tre dage og beder bilister parkere ved stadion og gå det sidste stykke. Flere boder holder kontantfrit i år, men der sættes to hæveautomater op ved toldboden. Fiskernes forening minder om, at erhvervskajen holdes fri, så kuttere kan lande fangsten om morgenen. Programmet offentliggøres i sin helhed på havnefestens side tre uger før start.
translated: Skagen Harbour Festival returns in the second week of July with a three-day programme on the quay at the fishing harbour. Thursday evening opens with local food trucks and a short concert by the harbour choir. Friday has a market for small-boat fishers and a children's workshop painting fish boxes. Saturday ends with a communal meal and fireworks at 22 if emergency services approve the final safety plan. Organisers expect about 8,000 guests over the three days and ask drivers to park at the stadium and walk the last stretch. Several stalls will be cashless this year, but two ATMs will be installed at the old customs house. The fishers' association reminds visitors that the commercial quay stays clear so cutters can land the morning catch. The full programme will be published on the festival site three weeks before the start.
summary: Skagen Harbour Festival returns in the second week of July with three days of food, markets, and a Saturday fireworks display. Organisers expect about 8,000 guests and ask visitors to park at the stadium.
